release_notes: Build 58 turns Autopilot Needs You into a unified task queue instead of a set of navigation shortcuts.

Related-video tasks now open the exact YouTube Short in Studio, copy the matching full-quiz title, open the full quiz for verification, and disappear only after the saved Related video is explicitly confirmed.
Prepared Instagram promos can now be reviewed and published directly from the Autopilot queue with the existing approved-account preflight and Instagram Reel upload service.
Instagram promo completion is recorded in the project promo metadata so Release Readiness and Autopilot stop asking for work that has already been completed.
Viewer reply drafts are shown as editable tasks with Open on YouTube and Send reply actions; public replies still require explicit confirmation before posting.
Successfully sent viewer replies are removed from Full Autopilot state, and replies sent through the existing YouTube Manager are also pruned from the queue during the same app session.

A Manage task queue button provides one place to work through Related videos, Instagram promos and viewer replies, while the existing Needs You buttons open the same queue pre-filtered to the relevant task type.
